definitions.gloss: front side; outer surface; right side (of fabric)
definitions.explanation: the side of an object meant to face outward or be seen, as opposed to the back or hidden side

examples.japanese: {表側|おもてがわ}を{見|み}てください。
examples.english: Please look at the front side.

examples.japanese: {布|ぬの}の{表側|おもてがわ}と{裏側|うらがわ}を{間違|まちが}えないで。
examples.english: Don't mix up the right side and wrong side of the fabric.

examples.japanese: この{建物|たてもの}の{表側|おもてがわ}は{大通|おおどお}りに{面|めん}していて、{裏側|うらがわ}には{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}がある。
examples.english: The front of this building faces the main street, and there's a parking lot at the back.

notes:
Combines {表|おもて} (front, surface) and {側|がわ} (side). Contrasts with {裏側|うらがわ} (back side, reverse side). Used for fabrics, buildings, coins, paper, and any object with a distinct front and back.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表側|おもてがわ}に{印刷|いんさつ}する: to print on the front side
- {表側|おもてがわ}を{上|うえ}にする: to place face up
- {建物|たてもの}の{表側|おもてがわ}: the front of a building
- {生地|きじ}の{表側|おもてがわ}: the right side of fabric

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {表面|ひょうめん}: surface — refers to the physical outer surface of an object, not specifically the front
- {正面|しょうめん}: front face — the side directly facing the viewer
- {裏側|うらがわ}: back side; reverse side — the antonym of {表側|おもてがわ}
